records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Total revenues increased $11.9 billion or 4.6% in 2020 compared to 2019.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Beginning in the second quarter and continuing throughout the remainder of the year, the Company experienced reduced customer traffic in its retail pharmacies and MinuteClinic locations due to shelter-in-place orders as well as reduced new therapy prescriptions and decreased long-term care prescription volume as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The value of ending inventory is reduced for estimated inventory losses that have occurred during the interim period between physical inventory counts.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In addition, the Company incurred incremental operating expenses associated with the Company’s COVID-19 pandemic response efforts and waived fees associated with prescription home delivery and associated front store products.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Operating income increased $1.9 billion or 16.1% in 2020 compared to 2019.
